label: ADC voltage Lambda probe behind catalytic converter
description: Signal voltage of the downstream (post-cat) narrowband O2 sensor. ~0.1 V lean, ~0.8 V rich; a steady value means the cat is storing oxygen.
note: Preferred downstream channel (refresh ~1.3/s).

label: Accepted generator torque
description: Alternator drag torque accepted by the DME into its torque model.

label: Actual gear
description: Gear currently engaged, as known by the DME.

label: Actual gear information from the gear sensor
description: Gear information straight from the transmission gear/selector sensor.
note: Duplicate of Actual gear for most uses.

label: Actual ignition angle
description: Actual spark advance (degrees before TDC). Drops when the DME retards for knock or torque reduction.

label: Actual inlet spread
description: Measured intake camshaft position (VANOS spread) relative to the crankshaft.

label: Actual oil pressure value (absolute pressure)
description: Measured engine oil pressure, absolute (includes ~1 bar atmospheric).

label: Actual operating mode
description: Current DME combustion/operating mode (e.g. normal homogeneous, catalyst heating).
note: Enum codes not documented; useful to split cold-start phases.

label: Actual operating mode, oil pressure control
description: Current stage of the map-controlled oil pump (low / high pressure stage).

label: Actual speed electr. water pump
description: Measured speed of the electric coolant pump.

label: Actual value exhaust spread BMW
description: Measured exhaust camshaft position (BMW spread definition).
note: Compare with Target angle camshaft exhaust closes.

label: Actual value intake spread BMW
description: Measured intake camshaft position (BMW spread definition).
note: Compare with Target angle (inlet VANOS).

label: Actual value of the eccentric angle VVT
description: Measured Valvetronic eccentric-shaft angle, which sets intake valve lift.
note: Compare with Setpoint eccentric angle VVT (135808).

label: Actual value of the outlet spread
description: Measured exhaust camshaft spread (alternative definition).

label: Adjustment of throttle valve model (factor)
description: Learned multiplicative correction of the throttle air-flow model (≈1.0 when nominal).
note: Drifts with throttle carbon build-up or air leaks.

label: Adjustment of throttle valve model (offset)
description: Learned additive offset correction of the throttle air-flow model.
note: A large offset can point to an unmetered air leak.

label: Adjustment range of the eccentric angle
description: Learned Valvetronic eccentric-shaft travel between its end stops.

label: Air damper - actual position in degrees
description: Active grille shutter, actual position (degrees).

label: Air damper - actual position in steps
description: Active grille shutter, actual position (motor steps).

label: Air damper - target position in degrees
description: Active grille shutter, target position (degrees).

label: Air damper - target position in steps
description: Active grille shutter, target position (motor steps).

label: Air flap - lower air flap status
description: Status of the lower active grille flap.

label: Air flap - upper air flap status
description: Status of the upper active grille flap.

label: Air mass flow
description: Engine air mass flow as calculated by the DME (main load signal).

label: Air mass flow HFM, corrected and filtered (for calculation of control difference mass flow controller)
description: Corrected and filtered MAF (HFM) value used by the mass-flow controller diagnosis.
note: The N55 normally has no physical MAF; may be modelled or static. Check in a log.

label: Air mass flow filtered
description: Filtered version of Air mass flow.

label: Ambient pressure
description: Barometric pressure used by the DME.
note: Baseline for boost/vacuum calculations.

label: Ambient pressure from sensor
description: Barometric pressure read from the sensor inside the DME.

label: Ambient pressure sensor voltage (10-bit from ADC)
description: Raw ADC reading of the barometric sensor.

label: Ambient temperature
description: Outside air temperature.
note: Good context tag for each log.

label: Angle inlet valve opens based on LWOT
description: Intake-valve opening angle relative to gas-exchange TDC (LWOT).
note: Results from VANOS position.

label: Average angle of rotation of the camshaft
description: Averaged camshaft angle measurement (cam/crank correlation).

label: Average of the measured values for mass flow diagnosis HFM in the LL
description: Idle (LL) average from the MAF plausibility diagnosis.
note: Probably only updates during the diagnostic run.

label: Boost pressure
description: Measured charge pressure upstream of the throttle (absolute).
note: Subtract ambient pressure for gauge boost.

label: Boost pressure from the sensor as an average
description: Averaged boost sensor reading.

label: Boost pressure raw value
description: Unfiltered boost sensor value.
note: Faster than the filtered value for lift-off analysis.

label: Boost pressure setpoint
description: Boost pressure target requested by the DME.

label: Clutch motor torque actual value
description: Actual engine torque at the crankshaft/clutch after losses.

label: Condition Level measurement error from the oil condition sensor
description: Flag: the oil condition/level sensor reports a measurement error.

label: Condition Vanos entrance at the ready
description: Flag: intake VANOS released and ready to control (after oil pressure builds).

label: Condition The probe behind the catalyst is sufficiently heated
description: Flag: downstream O2 sensor has reached operating temperature.
note: Filter downstream-sensor analysis on this.

label: Condition for detected knockers
description: Flag: knock detected (any cylinder).

label: Condition exhaust flap with resonator
description: Exhaust flap state (open/closed).

label: Condition oil sensor failure
description: Flag: oil condition sensor fault.

label: Condition probe ready for operation before cat
description: Flag: upstream wideband sensor ready, so closed-loop lambda control is possible.
note: Use to split open loop from closed loop.

label: Condition probe ready for operation behind cat
description: Flag: downstream sensor ready for operation.

label: Condition start request
description: Flag: engine start requested (start button or auto start-stop restart).

label: Condition super knocker
description: Flag: pre-ignition (super knock / LSPI) detected.

label: Confirmed target speed electr. water pump
description: Speed command acknowledged by the electric coolant pump.

label: Control unit temperature
description: Internal temperature of the DME.

label: Control difference boost pressure - bank-specific bank 1
description: Boost control error (setpoint minus actual).
note: Persistent positive value = underboost.

label: Coolant temperature
description: Engine coolant temperature.

label: Coolant temperature (sensor value) after low-pass filtering
description: Low-pass filtered coolant temperature.

label: Coordinated moment for filling
description: Torque request handed to the air path (slow, charge-based torque path).
note: Gap vs. actual torque shows when the air path lags.

label: Correction factor for the amount of fuel
description: Overall multiplicative correction applied to injected fuel quantity.

label: Correction factor height
description: Altitude correction factor.

label: Correction value of the LSU voltage before CAT
description: Learned offset correction of the upstream wideband (Bosch LSU) sensor voltage.
note: Large values suggest an ageing upstream sensor.

label: Correction value shutdown
description: Correction value learned at engine shutdown (purpose unclear).

label: Crankshaft adaptation exhaust takes place
description: Flag: exhaust cam/crank reference adaptation in progress.

label: Crankshaft adaptation intake takes place
description: Flag: intake cam/crank reference adaptation in progress.

label: Cross slope (estimated) in degrees
description: Estimated lateral (side) slope of the car.
note: Affects oil level readings.

label: Degree of utilization generator 1
description: Alternator load (field duty).

label: Delta probe offset master control
description: Trim correction from the downstream sensor applied to upstream lambda control.
note: Drifting value points to upstream sensor or cat ageing.

label: Difference between ambient pressure and brake booster pressure from pressure sensor (raw value)
description: Brake booster vacuum (ambient minus booster pressure), raw.
note: Booster/vacuum-pump health.

label: Differential pressure in front of the throttle valve between the start and the end of the dynamic test SSP
description: Result of a dynamic plausibility test on the pre-throttle pressure sensor.
note: Only changes when the test runs.

label: Engine oil level
description: Oil level from the oil condition sensor.
note: Unit/scale to confirm against the dipstick.

label: Engine speed
description: Engine speed.
note: Master time-base parameter for almost every preset.

label: Electric Fuel Pump
description: Command/state of the in-tank low-pressure fuel pump (EKP).

label: Effective engine power
description: Calculated current engine power output.

label: Engine starting temperature
description: Coolant temperature at engine start.
note: Key tag for sorting cold-start logs.

label: Exhaust camshaft position
description: Measured exhaust camshaft position.

label: Exhaust gas temperature according to KAT from model
description: Modelled exhaust gas temperature at the catalyst.
note: Model value, not a sensor.

label: Exhaust gas temperature behind main catalyst from model
description: Modelled exhaust gas temperature downstream of the main catalyst.
note: Model value, not a sensor.

label: Exhaust valve angle closes based on LWOT
description: Exhaust-valve closing angle relative to gas-exchange TDC.
note: Results from exhaust VANOS position.

label: Factor from lambda control adaptation for bank 1

label: Fast mean value of the lambda control factor
description: Short-window average of the lambda controller output (smoothed STFT).

label: Filtered rail pressure actual value (absolute pressure)

description: Measured spark burn duration, cylinder 4.

description: Measured spark burn duration, cylinder 6.

description: Ignition angle applied to cylinder 1.

label: Fuel mass flow
